title: GLASS: Global Latent Aggregation with Slot-based Set Decoding for Scalable All-Atom Crystal Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.37158v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative models for crystals enable the discovery of novel structures, but scaling all-atom generation to larger systems such as metal--organic frameworks remains challenging. We connect this difficulty to the correspondence problem of particle-space generation. Even on a single fixed target set, index-free permutation-equivariant particle flows require substantially more training for reliable generation as set size and density increase, under both independent and optimal-transport couplings. To resolve this challenge, we introduce GLASS---Global Latent Aggregation with Slot-based Set Decoding, which encodes structures in a permutation-invariant global latent space and learns their distribution via flow matching. A learned-slot decoder constructs all atoms in parallel, removing atom-wise correspondence from generative transport. translated_title: GLASS：基于全局潜在聚合与槽式集合解码的可扩展全原子晶体生成
translated_abstract: 晶体生成模型能够促进新结构的发现，但将全原子生成扩展到金属有机框架等更大体系仍然具有挑战性。我们将这一困难与粒子空间生成中的对应问题联系起来。研究表明，即使在单一固定目标集上，随着集合规模和密度的增加，无索引的置换等变粒子流无论在独立耦合还是最优传输耦合下，都需要大幅增加训练量才能实现可靠生成。为解决这一挑战，我们提出了GLASS——基于槽式集合解码的全局潜在聚合方法，该方法在置换不变的全局潜在空间中对结构进行编码，并通过流匹配学习其分布。学习式槽解码器并行构建所有原子，从而将原子级对应问题从生成传输中移除。在MP20数据集上，GLASS与粒子空间模型表现相当，且流训练可达到（摘要截断处）的有效性。
tldr: GLASS通过在置换不变的全局潜在空间中编码晶体结构，并利用槽式解码器并行生成所有原子，消除了粒子空间生成中的原子对应难题，从而实现了可扩展的全原子晶体生成。
en_tdlr: GLASS enables scalable all-atom crystal generation by encoding structures in a permutation-invariant global latent space and decoding all atoms in parallel with learned slots, eliminating the atom-wise correspondence problem in particle-space generative flows.
